title: Good horizontal truncation totalizes to decalage of the second filtration
statement: Let M be an integer-indexed bicomplex in a Grothendieck abelian category, with zero terms whenever either index is negative. Let q>=0, and let L be a decreasing filtration of its actual total whose degreewise steps are the second filtration [def-sp-double-complex-total]. The total of the good horizontal truncation tau<=q M is isomorphic to the actual shifted-cycle complex Dec(L)^(-q) [def-sp-filtered-complex-decalage], and its totalized truncation inclusion equals this isomorphism followed by the decalage inclusion.

source.document: Stacks Project, Derived Categories and Homology
source.place: Tag 015X, finite-diagonal kernel calculation for the second filtration

proof.text: Totalization sends a monomorphism of bicomplexes to a monomorphism: in each degree its map is a coproduct of the component monomorphisms, and coproducts are exact in a Grothendieck abelian category. Apply the degreewise image identity to obtain equality with the defining decalage intersection. The associated monic subobjects give canonical degreewise isomorphisms. Cancel the ambient monic inclusion to prove the differential equation and assemble a complex isomorphism compatible with inclusions.

lean.statement:
theorem good_truncation_total_decalage
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{v} C]
    (M : HomologicalComplex₂ C (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
    (hM : ∀ p r : ℤ, p < 0 ∨ r < 0 → IsZero ((M.X p).X r))
    (q : ℤ) (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    (L : CategoryTheory.DecreasingFiltration (M.total (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
    (hL : ∀ p m : ℤ, L.complexStep p m = (M.secondFiltration m).step p) :
    ∃ d : HomologicalComplex₂.total (CochainComplex.truncLE M q) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ≅
        L.decalageComplex (-q),
      HomologicalComplex₂.total.map (CochainComplex.ιTruncLE M q)
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ) = d.hom ≫ L.decalageι (-q)
